Juglindorët (Southeasterners) | founded = {{Start date and age|df=y|1926|08}} | ground = [[Skënderbeu Stadium]] | capacity = 12,343{{cite web|url=http://www.worldstadiums.com/europe/countries/albania.shtml|title=World Stadiums – Stadiums in Albania|work=worldstadiums.com|access-date=10 March 2017}} | owner = [[Korçë|Korçë Municipality]] | chrtitle = President | chairman = Ardian Takaj | manager = [[Julian Ahmataj]] | league = [[Kategoria Superiore]] | season = [[2025–26 Kategoria e Parë|2025–26]] | position = [[Kategoria e Parë]], 2nd (promoted) | website = {{URL|kfskenderbeu.al}} | current = | pattern_la1 = _tunisia1718a | pattern_b1 = _uhlsportstripe19rw | pattern_ra1 = _tunisia1718a | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = ff0000 | body1 = ff0000 | rightarm1 = ff0000 | shorts1 = ff0000 | socks1 = ff0000 | pattern_la2 = _uhlsportgoal25w | pattern_b2 = _uhlsportgoal25w | pattern_ra2 = _uhlsportgoal25w | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = ffffff | body2 = ffffff | rightarm2 = ffffff | shorts2 = ffffff | socks2 = ffffff }} '''Klubi i Futbollit Skënderbeu''' is an Albanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Korçë]], southeastern [[Albania]]. The club competes in the [[Kategoria Superiore]], the first tier of [[Football in Albania|Albanian football]]. An amateur club named ''Vllazëria Korçë'' was founded in 1909.{{cite web |publisher=kfskenderbeu.al |title=KF Skënderbeu history |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20240617051716/https://kfskenderbeu.al/histori/ |url=https://korcablog.com/2019/10/18/historia-e-klubit-kf-skenderbeu/ |access-date=29 November 2024 |archive-date=2024-06-17 |language=sq}}{{cite web |publisher=korcablog.com |title=Historia e klubit KF Skënderbeu |url=https://korcablog.com/2019/10/18/historia-e-klubit-kf-skenderbeu/ |access-date=29 November 2024 |language=sq}} The club in its current form was established on August 1926 by Fazlli Frashëri, known as Sportklub Korça, later changing its name to Skënderbeu, after Albania's national hero [[Skanderbeg]].{{cite news |last1=Hasani |first1=Vepror |title=Skënderbeu i Korçës, ja kush ishin tre njerëzit që e bënë të lavdishëm. |url=https://telegraf.al/sport/skenderbeu-i-korces-ja-kush-ishin-tre-njerezit-qe-e-bene-te-lavdishem/ |agency=Gazeta Telegraf |date=29 January 2015}} The club's home ground has been the [[Skënderbeu Stadium]] since it was built in 1957, and it now has a capacity of 12,343, of which 5,724 are seated.{{fact|date=June 2024}} Skënderbeu Korçë have won 8 [[Kategoria Superiore|league titles]], with the first coming in 1933 before going on 78-year run without winning the league. The club won its first league title since 1933 in 2011, and they have won the league 6 more times since. The club had won six consecutive league titles since 2011, breaking the Albanian record which had been held by [[Dinamo Tirana]] who had won four consecutive titles in the 1950s.{{fact|date=June 2024}} In 2015, the club became the first Albanian side to reach the play-off round of the [[UEFA Champions League]] but they lost to [[GNK Dinamo Zagreb|Dinamo Zagreb]] and dropped into the [[UEFA Europa League]], and became the first Albanian side to qualify for the group stages of a UEFA competition."}}
